doubts: The page never calls the route a loop or circuit; the shape comes from the day headings, which start and finish at the Hollyford Road end, with the Hollyford Track walked both out (to Lake Alabaster Hut) and back (from Martins Bay Hut), so part of it is shared. No direction is named. The intro gives '88 km' for the route, but the section distances add to far more, so no distance is recorded for the way. McKenzie Creek has two name entries and neither is clearly at the southern end of Big Bay, so its ref is null. The Hollyford Track sections are described only by a link, so huts on them are not listed.
